title: Critique: an illusion of consciousness would itself be an experience

statements.text: Some philosophers hold that strong illusionism refutes itself: an illusion is an experience, so if consciousness is an illusion, the illusion is a phenomenally conscious state after all. Chalmers reports this charge and rejects it, since a strong illusionist can take illusions to be judgments, intuitions or dispositions to report.

sources.quote: so that if consciousness is an illusion, the illusion is itself an experience
The strong illusionist can simply understand illusions non-experientially as judgments
